saw_lines: Buyers of design pieces often compare for weeks, then choose by how the piece fits their room.
So a buyer who clicks a text ad finds no product and no reason to buy, and the click is wasted.
Your 12 Google creatives, 10 images and 2 text ads, show error messages in both text ads. Swap them for copy naming the product and one reason to buy now.
ads_1: Google text ads built around the product and one buyer reason
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
